business_summary: Shiprocket Limited provides e-commerce enablement platform solutions in India. It offers Shiprocket Shipping, an e-commerce shipping platform that automates workflows across sales channels; ShiprocketX, an end-to-end cross border solution; fastrr, AI native growth suite for commerce brands; Shiprocket Fulfillment, a warehousing, and packaging and shipping solution; Shiprocket Trends; and Shiprocket Capital, a revenue-based financing platform. The company also provides Shiprocket Packaging for packaging solutions; Shiprocket Cargo, a platform that offers end-to-end logistics partner for domestic freight movement; Shiprocket Omuni, an unified commerce platform; Shiprocket Promise for shopping; Shiprocket Amplify, an influencer marketing solution; Shiprocket Quick, a delivery solution; Delivery Boost, a delivery solutions; and Shiprocket Sense for address and risk intelligence to minimise address inaccuracies and delivery failuresa. It serves small businesses, retail brands, direct-to-consumer merchants, and social commerce retailers. Shiprocket Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Gurugram, India.
